description: Change 1 to 20 existing DNS records of a Cloudflare zone in one batch: all are changed or none is, and each change is checked against the record's current values before anything is sent. Each change names a record by id (cloudflare_dns_read list shows it) and gives only the fields to change; fields left out keep their value, and an empty comment removes the comment. A record's type cannot change in place: use cloudflare_dns_record_delete with the replacement in its add. Records managed by another Cloudflare product (a Worker's custom domain, for one) are refused, and so are changes that change nothing. The values follow the rules of cloudflare_dns_record_add, applied to the record as it would be after the change; for example a proxied record needs an automatic ttl. The result lists each record before and after. If the batch fails without telling whether it was applied, read the records with cloudflare_dns_read before sending it again. Zones are looked up only in the account's own zones.

account.description: The label of the credential pair to use, or "default" for the unlabeled one; left out, the unlabeled pair, else the only label.

changes.description: 1 to 20 records to change, each by id with only the fields to change; all or none.

comment.description: The new one-line note on the record, up to 500 characters; an empty string removes the comment. Leave out to keep it.

content.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS: the new value (an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address, a hostname, or the text of a TXT record). Not allowed for CAA and SRV. Leave out to keep it.

data.description: CAA (flags, tag, value) and SRV (priority, weight, port, target): the new structured value, all its keys, replacing the old one. Not allowed for the other types. Leave out to keep it.

flags.description: CAA: the flags, 0–255 (0 for most records).

priority.description: SRV: the priority, 0–65535 (lower is tried first).

tag.description: CAA: the property tag, one of issue, issuewild, iodef, issuemail, issuevmc.

target.description: SRV: the host that serves it, or "." when the service is not offered.

value.description: CAA: the property value, such as the CA's domain.

id.description: The id of the record to change (32 hex digits); cloudflare_dns_read list shows it.

name.description: The new record name: relative to the zone ("www", "_dmarc"), "@" for the apex, or full. Leave out to keep it.

priority.description: MX only: the new preference, 0–65535 (lower is tried first); SRV takes its priority in `data`. Leave out to keep it.

proxied.description: A, AAAA, CNAME only: send traffic through Cloudflare (true) or not (false). A proxied record's TTL is automatic. Leave out to keep it.

ttl.description: The new seconds to live: 1 for automatic, or 60–86400. Leave out to keep it.

type.description: The record's current type. Leave it out; if given it must match, since a record's type cannot change in place.

name: cloudflare_dns_record_edit

changed.description: The records that changed, in the order of `changes`.

comment.description: The comment on the record, or null.

content.description: The record content, as Cloudflare shows it.

data.description: The structured fields of types such as CAA, SRV or URI.

modified_on.description: When the record was last modified, or null.

priority.description: The priority of MX, SRV and URI records.

proxiable.description: Whether the record can be proxied.

read_only.description: Whether another Cloudflare product manages the record (a Worker's custom domain, for one): it cannot be changed or deleted here, and the zone file leaves it out.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; 1 means automatic.

type.description: The record type (e.g. A, CNAME, MX, TXT).

after.description: The record as Cloudflare reports it now; null when the batch result did not include it.

comment.description: The comment on the record, or null.

content.description: The record content, as Cloudflare shows it.

data.description: The structured fields of types such as CAA, SRV or URI.

modified_on.description: When the record was last modified, or null.

priority.description: The priority of MX, SRV and URI records.

proxiable.description: Whether the record can be proxied.
